jei.primordial.learn.label: How to learn:
jei.primordial.learn.boss: Only the Seven Sin Lords carry this recipe. Defeat a Sin Lord and obtain it from their drops.
jei.primordial.learn.core: Epiphany: Equip Sage’s Gift and kill the corresponding boss with at least %s affixes (Overworld: Warden; Nether: Wither; End: Ender Dragon).
jei.primordial.learn.sigil: Epiphany: Equip Sage’s Gift and witness the Primordial Lord’s death from less than %s blocks away while alive and outside Creative or Spectator mode.
jei.primordial.learn.transmutation: Epiphany: Equip Sage’s Gift and kill a mob with an affix state. Any qualifying kill can teach this recipe while it remains unlearned.
jei.primordial.learn.truth: Epiphany: Equip Sage’s Gift after learning %s other alchemy recipes. Equipping it after reaching the threshold also triggers this epiphany.
jei.primordial.learn.copy: Find and read this recipe from chest fragments or scrolls. On a Basic Alchemy Altar or higher, combine an original recipe, paper, an ink sac, a feather and two Alchemical Essences to make two copies preserving its knowledge data. The original recipe’s knowledge need not be learned.
jei.primordial.learn.findable: Recipe fragments or scrolls are scattered in chests throughout the world, with especially rich finds in the Spirit Realm. Read the recovered recipe to learn it.
bond.primordial.throng.desc: 30% of the healing you receive is given to your clones too; while a clone stands you take 10% less damage; when a clone falls you heal 2
bond.primordial.unmoving.desc: Stand still for 2s to settle: your damage cap's per-hit limit drops by another 25% and reflection is +50%; moving ends it at once (the tighter cap does nothing against fixed damage)
bond.primordial.breach.desc: Repeated hits on one target build Breach: -3% to its armor and resistances per stack, up to 5 (lost after 5s without a hit); at full stacks your next attack ignores its damage cap
bond.primordial.binding.desc: Your curses and seals last 50% longer; a target carrying your curse takes 20% more magic damage
bond.primordial.heavenbind.desc: Targets you slowed have a 20% chance every 3s to draw down lightning; hitting a desaturated target renews its befuddlement (it turns on nearby monsters for 3s)
bond.primordial.naming.desc: Malice's chance and length are doubled (40%, 10s); Blood Pact's healing is multiplied by Amplify once more; your aura-like effects reach 2 blocks further
bond.primordial.unquenched.desc: A killing blow does not kill: your health rolls back to what it was 3s ago and a Ruin blast strikes everything within 4 blocks; 5 min cooldown. The only rewind in the mod
bond.primordial.aegis.desc: A further 8% reduction to all damage (a multiplier of its own); harmful effects and statuses last 30% shorter
bond.primordial.wheel.desc: Falling into the void or a lethal fall takes you back to where you stood about 5s ago (health is not rolled back); 3 min cooldown
bond.primordial.faded_world.desc: Every 4s, enemies within 8 blocks gain a stack of Desaturation; +15% crit chance against desaturated enemies
bond.primordial.defiance.desc: Below 50% health, +15% attack; below 25%, +30% attack and you regrow 1% of your max health every second
bond.primordial.spacetime.desc: When hit, 10% chance to slip aside and take nothing (a dodge: works on fixed damage too); 5s internal cooldown
bond.primordial.karma.desc: Harmful effects and statuses on you last 40% shorter; the potion time cut away is passed as a curse to whatever last hurt you
bond.primordial.blood_for_blood.desc: 30% of the damage your reflection deals heals you
bond.primordial.longevity.desc: Regeneration's overflow healing becomes golden blood (within golden blood's own capacity)
bond.primordial.empty_gate.desc: A single hit above 20% of your max health has a 25% chance to be swallowed whole by the void; 10s cooldown (does nothing against fixed damage)
bond.primordial.thunderclap.desc: Lightning you call down adds 2 layers of Armor Shred (-6% armor each, up to 5, for 5s)
bond.primordial.embers.desc: Your clones explode when they fall, dealing 50% of your attack to enemies within 3 blocks
bond.primordial.spell_body.desc: A quarter of your non-physical damage reduction is added to your magic damage
bond.primordial.awakening.desc: Each clone you call gets one weak blessing at random: Amplify (+20% attack), Regeneration (heals every second) or Strength (+2 attack)

jei.primordial.info.spirit_compass:
The Spirit Compass points to your next goal: a guardian's court, a Sin Lord's sanctum, the Primordial Temple, the Court of Truth and more.

To get one: hold any Sin Lord's affix material and use it on an enchanting table, giving the material and 30 levels.

Use: turn to the next goal; sneak and use: back to the first. Held, it shows the goal's name, distance, dimension and coordinates at the top left. While the goal is in another dimension or not yet found, its needle turns slowly.
